purpose: Independently preselected station-only sensitivity; retain DE440 body, orientation and reflector data, all frozen points and original tolerances
time_interpretation: The source specifies J2000.0 and metres/year, but does not explicitly restate the time scale of station propagation. TT Julian years are an explicit diagnostic interpretation; not a recovered software setting.
frame: Jointly fitted LUNAR ITRS station solution; compared with ITRF2008, not guaranteed canonical ITRF2008 or matched to DE440/ICRF EOP
origin: Geocentric ITRS; no additional fitted translation or Helmert transform
tide_system: Conventional tide-free, following the inherited station model described by Biskupek 2015 section 4.2.3
reference_point: System reference point (SRP), intersection of telescope axes; no extra instrument eccentricity inferred

hofmann2017.title: Lunar Laser Ranging: Verbesserte Modellierung der Monddynamik und Schätzung relativistischer Parameter
hofmann2017.location: Section 5.3 and Tables 5.4-5.5, printed pp.65-67 (tables PDF page69); fixed Matera velocity in Table A.3, printed p.118; SRP identifiers in Table A.1, printed p.117

biskupek2015.title: Bestimmung der Erdorientierung mit Lunar Laser Ranging
biskupek2015.location: Sections 4.2.2-4.2.3, printed pp.34-36: SRP, J2000.0, conventional tide-free coordinates and linear station velocities; APOLLO approximate White Sands GPS a priori velocity

hofmann2017-apollo-standard.velocity_status: Estimated in the standard joint solution
hofmann2017-apollo-standard.reference_frame_limitation: APOLLO had no official ITRF coordinate: Murphy private communication 2008 provided the a priori position, with the nearby White Sands GPS velocity. The fitted output is not an official ITRF2008 realization.

hofmann2017-matera-standard.velocity_status: Fixed to the ITRF2008 a priori velocity in Table A.3; no fitted velocity uncertainty

limitations: Use Tables 5.4-5.5 standard solution only. Tables 5.6 and A.5 describe a separate constrained-velocity solution and are not combined here.
Internal component uncertainties are metadata only; full covariance and a propagated station uncertainty are unavailable.

The source jointly fits an independently integrated lunar ephemeris, lunar rotation, reflector coordinates and other parameters; its updates use DE430/GRAIL information. This is not a matched fixed-DE440 station solution.

Earth displacement models include solid Earth tides, ocean loading, atmospheric loading, pole and ocean pole tides. Their original realizations are not reproduced by changing station coordinates alone.
Source measurements extend through early 2015. Both frozen observations postdate that fitting interval; station discontinuities and later local metrology are not established by this source.
No source range biases, empirical lunar librations, reflector positions, or frame transformations are imported. No choice based on residuals.
